map.根据粉丝数和互动率估算网红/KOL的合理合作报价: Estimate a fair collaboration quote for influencers and KOLs from follower count and engagement rate
map.📖 查看「网红/达人报价计算器 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Influencer Pricing Calculator User Guide"
map.达人报价估算：按粉丝量级取基础 CPM，报价 = 粉丝数 ÷ 1000 × CP: Influencer pricing estimate: take a base CPM by follower tier, then quote = followers / 1000 × CPM × engagement factor × platform factor × content type factor.
map.内容形式系数（图文1.0,短视频1.5,直播2.5）: Content format factor (image + text 1.0, short video 1.5, livestream 2.5)
map.按粉丝量、互动、平台、内容形式估一条笔记合理报价区间。: Estimate a fair quote range for one post from follower count, engagement, platform and content format.
map.对比多个达人 CPM（千粉成本）选高性价比。: Compare cost per thousand followers across influencers to pick the best value.
map.预算有限时反推能覆盖多少粉丝量级。: Work back how large a follower tier a limited budget can cover.
map.粉丝 5 万（50k）、基础千粉价 10 元、互动加成 1.2、平台系数 1.0: Followers 50000 (50k), base price per thousand followers 10 CNY, engagement uplift 1.2, platform factor 1.0 and content factor 1.0 gives a quote of 50×10×1.2×1×1 = 600 CNY, with a reasonable range of 420-780 CNY (±30%).
map.达人 A 报价 600 触达 5 万（千粉 12 元），达人 B 报价 900: Influencer A charges 600 to reach 50000 (12 CNY per thousand followers) while influencer B charges 900 to reach 120000 (7.5 per thousand); B has the lower unit cost and is better value.
map.报价区间怎么来的？: Where does the quote range come from?
map.以基准报价为中心 ±30% 给出区间，实际受档期、独家、返点影响，区间仅作议价锚: It is the base quote ±30%. Real quotes shift with availability, exclusivity and rebates, so the range only anchors negotiation.
map.粉丝多就一定贵？: Do more followers always cost more?
map.不一定。互动率低的「僵尸粉」账号千粉成本高、转化差，应看互动加成后的有效报价。: Not necessarily. Accounts with low engagement and zombie followers carry a high cost per thousand and convert poorly, so judge the effective quote after the engagement uplift.
